title: Augment the training crops
summary: Random changes to the training crops each epoch: box jitter, intensity, blur, noise, or the strong set.
does: The augmenters of tools/train_blocks.py, applied in their fixed order (AUGMENT_ORDER) whatever order they are named in: box-jitter, intensity, blur, noise, and strong, SyntheX's strong randomisation (#252). They change the training crops only; validation and test are read as they are. None named is version 1's training.

outputs.name: data
outputs.what: The same data; the changes are drawn while training.

params.name: augment
params.what: the changes, each named at most once

nondeterminism: The changes are drawn afresh every epoch from the training run's random state, so a run repeats them only under the same training seed.

generic.why: The augmenters change 2-D crops (tools/train_blocks.py AUGMENTERS); a volume or a clip would need 3-D or time-consistent versions.
